newsitem.title: UK: Rentokil falls despite 48 pct profit boost.
newsitem.headline: Rentokil falls despite 48 pct profit boost.

text.p: Shares in business services company Rentokil Group Plc opened sharply lower on Wednesday after the group reported a rise in pretax profit and sales which were heavily dependent on the contribution of BET, a rival group acquired by Rentokil last year.
The shares were 22-1/2p lower at 435-1/2p by 0830 GMT.
The group said pretax profit had risen 48 percent to 318 million stg whilst sales were 167 percent higher at 2.34 billion stg. Rentokil announced a two-for-one share split at the same time.
Analysts had been expecting profits in the range of 317-335 million stg.
Rentokil also met its long-standing self-imposed target to raise earnings by at least 20 percent each year.

"They managed the 20 percent gain again although the contribution from BET is very substantial," commented one equity salesman. "People will be asking about their core businesses and wondering whether they would have made the grade without BET."
